name: Vital Signs
description: Measure heart rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, temperature, and oxygen saturation

name: Physical Examination
description: Complete physical examination including auscultation, palpation, and inspection

name: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
description: Measures white blood cells, red blood cells, hemoglobin, hematocrit, and platelets

name: Basic Metabolic Panel (BMP)
description: Measures glucose, electrolytes (sodium, potassium, chloride), BUN, and creatinine

name: Urinalysis
description: Tests urine for infection, blood, protein, glucose, and other abnormalities

name: Chest X-Ray
description: Standard chest radiograph to evaluate lungs, heart, and mediastinum

name: Electrocardiogram (EKG/ECG)
description: Records electrical activity of the heart to detect arrhythmias and ischemia

name: Blood Cultures
description: Tests for bacterial or fungal infection in the bloodstream

name: Sputum Culture & Gram Stain
description: Identifies bacteria in respiratory secretions

name: Liver Function Tests (LFTs)
description: Measures ALT, AST, bilirubin, albumin, and prothrombin time

name: Troponin
description: Cardiac enzyme marker for myocardial infarction

name: B-type Natriuretic Peptide (BNP)
description: Marker for heart failure

name: D-Dimer
description: Screening test for deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism

name: CT Chest
description: Computed tomography of the chest for detailed lung and mediastinal evaluation

name: CT Pulmonary Angiography (CTPA)
description: CT scan with contrast to detect pulmonary embolism

name: MRI Chest
description: Magnetic resonance imaging of the chest for detailed soft tissue evaluation

name: Echocardiogram
description: Ultrasound of the heart to evaluate structure and function

name: Arterial Blood Gas (ABG)
description: Measures pH, pCO2, pO2, and bicarbonate to assess acid-base balance and oxygenation

name: Lumbar Puncture
description: Cerebrospinal fluid analysis for infection or bleeding

name: Bronchoscopy
description: Direct visualization of airways and collection of samples

name: Pulmonary Function Tests
description: Measures lung volumes and airflow to assess respiratory function

name: V/Q Scan
description: Nuclear medicine scan to detect pulmonary embolism

name: Abdominal Ultrasound
description: Ultrasound imaging of abdominal organs

name: CT Abdomen/Pelvis
description: Computed tomography of abdomen and pelvis with contrast

name: Lipid Panel
description: Measures cholesterol, triglycerides, HDL, and LDL

name: Coagulation Panel (PT/INR, PTT)
description: Tests blood clotting function

name: Thyroid Function Tests (TSH, T4)
description: Evaluates thyroid hormone levels
